description: Server-side code for handling public estimate portal page, including loading estimate data and accepting/declining estimates via API endpoints.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches estimate data based on token parameter; manages errors and returns estimate info for rendering.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Handles user acceptance of the estimate by POST request to API endpoint, with error handling.

methods.name: decline
methods.description: Handles user declining the estimate by POST request to API endpoint, with error handling.
